        - []

## Section

This document is in a subdirectory of the project, and the `langfile` extension is at the root of the project.
The path to the language file of the extension starts with `../`.
Before the fix, this case worked by chance, because the wrong base directory and the `../` offset cancelled each other out.
This test makes sure that the case continues to work.
